basics.name: Kalle Nurmela
basics.label: Principal Consultant, Architect, Team Lead, Developer
basics.summary:
Kalle is a full-stack software developer and architect with over 21 years of experience. He finds learning the latest technologies intriguing, but people come first and foremost. Improving the processes requires much more than simply cranking out software.

He began his career in the telecom industry getting to be one of the early adopters of Scrum in Finland. Later he spent a significant part of his career building and improving systems critical to national security.

Gaming has been close to his heart since he got his first home computer as a child, and it still is his favourite pastime.
basics.x-tagline: Software is made by people and for people. Tools keep changing and parts of the work get automated, yet the way we build things must never outweigh the reason we build them.

x-strengths.title: It's all about people
x-strengths.description: People have goals to achieve, tasks to be done and fun to be had. Software can help in all of these, but to successfully build it, we need to communicate, be curious and have empathy for each other and ourselves.

x-strengths.title: Live to learn
x-strengths.description: As human beings, we are never truly finished with our learning. New ideas, new technologies, new challenges and new opportunities; you never know what the new day brings.

projects.name: Trust & Safety tooling
projects.description:
Improving the moderation processes by designing and building tools for automated content moderation and Fair Play for large-scale online mobile games. These tools help the human moderators in handling vast amounts of chat and other user-generated content that needs moderation and help in Fair Play investigations ensuring fair and equal treatment of all players. The work includes backend, UI, and AWS infrastructure.

Day-to-day responsibilities include coordinating the technical planning of new products and assisting in their high-level planning aligning the technologies and implementations with business needs. Doing project management for new features. Communicating with the end users both to proactively to introduce features and fixes and reactively to support the use of current tools. Contributing to best practices on reliability and availability, and together with the rest of the team, contributing to the continuous improvement of Trust & Safety services. Working in collaboration with a multidisciplinary team of Trust & Safety specialists, data and engineering specialists, other consultants, and product and game teams.

A customized agile development process defined by the client was used.

projects.name: Operational planning system rebuild
projects.description:
The scope of the project was a complete rebuild of an operational planning system for a defence sector client. Started with the initial requirements gathering phase and supported sales in technical aspects such as feasibility and cost estimations. The project used a Scrum-like process with short iterations and feedback from the client.

Started project with a small group of architects doing architectural spikes (frontend—backend—database) to prove the feasibility of the technology choices. For implementation, the team was expanded to 8–10 developers, and Kalle took on the additional responsibilities of project management including budgeting, risk management and quality management. Also, on one occasion the resolution of internal team conflict.
